record.bible_text: For Zion's<WH06726> sake will I not hold my peace<WH02814><WTH8799>, and for Jerusalem's<WH03389> sake I will not rest<WH08252><WTH8799>, until the righteousness<WH06664> thereof go forth<WH03318><WTH8799> as brightness<WH05051>, and the salvation<WH03444> thereof as a lamp<WH03940> <FI>that<Fi> burneth<WH01197><WTH8799>.

And the Gentiles<WH01471> shall see<WH07200><WTH8804> thy righteousness<WH06664>, and all kings<WH04428> thy glory<WH03519>: and thou shalt be called<WH07121><WTH8795> by a new<WH02319> name<WH05344><WTH8799>, which the mouth<WH06310> of the LORD<WH03068> shall name<WH08034>.
Thou shalt also be a crown<WH05850> of glory<WH08597> in the hand<WH03027> of the LORD<WH03068>, and a royal<WH04410> diadem<WH06797><WTH8675><WH06797> in the hand<WH03709> of thy God<WH0430>.

Thou shalt no more be termed<WH0559><WTH8735> Forsaken<WH05800><WTH8803>; neither shall thy land<WH0776> any more be termed<WH0559><WTH8735> Desolate<WH08077>: but thou shalt be called<WH07121><WTH8735> Hephzibah<WH02657>, and thy land<WH0776> Beulah<WH01166><WTH8803>: for the LORD<WH03068> delighteth<WH02654><WTH8804> in thee, and thy land<WH0776> shall be married<WH01166><WTH8735>. <RF>Hephzibah: that is, My delight is in her<Rf> <RF>Beulah: that is, Married<Rf>

For <FI>as<Fi> a young man<WH0970> marrieth<WH01166><WTH8799> a virgin<WH01330>, <FI>so<Fi> shall thy sons<WH01121> marry<WH01166><WTH8799> thee: and <FI>as<Fi> the bridegroom<WH02860> rejoiceth<WH04885> over the bride<WH03618>, <FI>so<Fi> shall thy God<WH0430> rejoice<WH07797><WTH8799> over thee. <RF>as the...: Heb. with the joy of the bridegroom<Rf><CM>

I have set<WH06485><WTH8689> watchmen<WH08104><WTH8802> upon thy walls<WH02346>, O Jerusalem<WH03389>, <FI>which<Fi> shall never<WH08548> hold their peace<WH02814><WTH8799> day<WH03117> nor night<WH03915>: ye that make mention<WH02142><WTH8688> of the LORD<WH03068>, keep not silence<WH01824>, <RF>make...: or, are the LORD's remembrancers<Rf>

And give<WH05414><WTH8799> him no rest<WH01824>, till he establish<WH03559><WTH8787>, and till he make<WH07760><WTH8799> Jerusalem<WH03389> a praise<WH08416> in the earth<WH0776>. <RF>rest: Heb. silence<Rf>

The LORD<WH03068> hath sworn<WH07650><WTH8738> by his right hand<WH03225>, and by the arm<WH02220> of his strength<WH05797>, Surely I will<WH0518> no more give<WH05414><WTH8799> thy corn<WH01715> <FI>to be<Fi> meat<WH03978> for thine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802>; and the sons<WH01121> of the stranger<WH05236> shall not drink<WH08354><WTH8799> thy wine<WH08492>, for the which thou hast laboured<WH03021><WTH8804>: <RF>Surely...: Heb. If I give, etc<Rf>

But they that have gathered<WH0622><WTH8764> it shall eat<WH0398><WTH8799> it, and praise<WH01984><WTH8765> the LORD<WH03068>; and they that have brought it together<WH06908><WTH8764> shall drink<WH08354><WTH8799> it in the courts<WH02691> of my holiness<WH06944>.<CM>

Go through<WH05674><WTH8798>, go through<WH05674><WTH8798> the gates<WH08179>; prepare<WH06437><WTH8761> ye the way<WH01870> of the people<WH05971>; cast up<WH05549><WTH8798>, cast up<WH05549><WTH8798> the highway<WH04546>; gather out<WH05619><WTH8761> the stones<WH068>; lift up<WH07311><WTH8685> a standard<WH05251> for the people<WH05971>.

Behold, the LORD<WH03068> hath proclaimed<WH08085><WTH8689> unto the end<WH07097> of the world<WH0776>, Say<WH0559><WTH8798> ye to the daughter<WH01323> of Zion<WH06726>, Behold, thy salvation<WH03468> cometh<WH0935><WTH8802>; behold, his reward<WH07939> <FI>is<Fi> with him, and his work<WH06468> before<WH06440> him. <RF>work: or, recompence<Rf>

And they shall call<WH07121><WTH8804> them, The holy<WH06944> people<WH05971>, The redeemed<WH01350><WTH8803> of the LORD<WH03068>: and thou shalt be called<WH07121><WTH8735>, Sought out<WH01875><WTH8803>, A city<WH05892> not forsaken<WH05800><WTH8737>.<CM>
